pr_title: Fix keyboard controls not working to adjust skin settings
pr_body:
This fixes the skin editor not blocking non-positional input, resulting in gameplay components potentially handling it before local elements (due to precedence of `KeyBindingContainer` events, see https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/issues/3992).

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/17346
pr_comments:
I think the inability to change volume is fine. Importantly, it *does* still work if you use the alternative keys (for me on macOS it's opt-up / opt-down):

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/159415165-b7f4c104-d0ae-4793-b2c0-04353d55ee6a.mp4

issue_context.title: Skin editor doesn't properly take keyboard input focus when watching a replay
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Skin editor's element settings sliders don't properly take keyboard left and right arrow input when editing gameplay. When the left or right arrow keys are pressed, the replay is seeked instead of adjusting the slider bar.

When editing song select, the left and right arrow keys properly move the slider, same thing when editing a skin during live gameplay (since arrow keys don't do anything then).

### Screenshots or videos

The slider in question:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16479013/159125068-50eb15bd-8f3a-49fa-aff1-79a07dcafbac.png)


### Version

2022.391.0

### Logs

[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8309424/network.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8309425/performance.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8309426/runtime.log)
[updater.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8309427/updater.log)
comments: this is because replay seeking is using `KeyBindingContainer` and sliders are using `OnKeyDown()`. making https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/issues/3992 the actual underlying issue here.
Probably okay to keep this tracking the issue?

It's doing the opposite of the linked framework issue. Probably because of:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/866ae3472bb654af5bde50f79ecb0ae2cbd884e5/osu.Game/Input/Bindings/GlobalActionContainer.cs#L131-L138
A high level solution to this is likely to stop input from reaching the target screens when the skin editor is active. I'll take a look at how simple this is to acheive.

review_comments: Since the logic has moved from `Show` to `PopIn`, I think scheduling inside of this method should no longer be necessary as they're invoked after the overlay is in a loaded state (see https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/blob/cd289a0adafdbe1660446a86719c7436b40f7338/osu.Framework/Graphics/Containers/VisibilityContainer.cs#L40-L45).

Is this test no longer required in favour of `TestSceneScreenNavigation.TestEditComponentDuringGameplay`? I would think so given that `SkinEditor` is used here instead of `SkinEditorOverlay` which actually blocks input.

Unless this is an additional test which ensure editing components using keyboard input actually works.
I felt like having it isn't an issue, and could be built on going forward.
